record.paper_title: Open Problems and Conjectures on Rational Systems in Three Dimensions
record.context_brief: convergence for a second-order rational recurrence
record.original_question: Consider the recurrence z_{n+1} = (alpha + beta z_n)/(A + z_n + C z_{n-1}), for n = 0, 1, .... Assume A >= 0, all other parameters are positive, the initial conditions are nonnegative, and the denominators are never zero. Does every solution converge?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\alpha, \beta, C > 0$ and $A \geq 0$ be real parameters. Consider the second-order rational recurrence
$$z_{n+1} = \frac{\alpha + \beta z_n}{A + z_n + C z_{n-1}}, \qquad n = 0, 1, 2, \ldots,$$
with nonnegative initial conditions $z_{-1}, z_0 \geq 0$ chosen so that the denominator $A + z_n + C z_{n-1}$ is nonzero for every $n \geq 0$. Determine whether every such solution $(z_n)_{n \geq -1}$ converges to a (finite) limit as $n \to \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The recurrence appears as a conjecture in the Camouzis–Ladas program on rational difference equations and their three-dimensional systems. A web search did not surface a definitive proof or disproof of global convergence for this specific equation; related second- and third-order rational equations have been studied (e.g., by Camouzis–Ladas and follow-up papers), but no source clearly resolves this particular conjecture, so the status is taken as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of Third-Order Rational Difference Equations with Open Problems and Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Numerous open problems and conjectures on boundedness, global stability and convergence of rational difference equations.
status_evidence.claim: This monograph collects many such convergence conjectures for rational recurrences; resolution status of individual conjectures varies and is not uniformly settled.

status_evidence.title: Some Problems of Second-Order Rational Difference Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Treatment of second-order rational difference equations and related Camouzis–Ladas conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Follow-up literature addresses some but not all Camouzis–Ladas conjectures on second-order rational recurrences.
